title: Pending Apply causes continuous rendering on idle screens
reproduction: Leave a source or rule change unapplied, stop touching the screen and sample rendered frames for four seconds.
expected: The action button remains usable above Apply without redrawing after animations settle.
observed: Sources drew 250 additional frames and Custom Rules 231; without the prompt the same screens were idle.
fix: Remove the full-screen list anchor from each action button; leave bottom/end gravity and Coordinator inset handling intact.
test_evidence: Signed before/after, matched API 34. Sources and Rules both added zero frames after the fix; Log also stayed idle and could pause recording. Structured XML regression failed before and passed after. See deep-signoff/pending-apply-and-locale.md.

title: Hebrew parsing status joins the source name to the preceding word
reproduction: Inspect Hebrew parse progress for the default AdAway Official source.
expected: A space separates the words from the variable source name.
observed: deep-home/11-initial-home.txt shows the name touching the prefix.
fix: Separate the resource placeholder from the preceding word without altering the source name.
test_evidence: Compared original signed capture with current resource placeholder and successful package build; no new timing-dependent visible parse capture claimed.
